info.name: CalcReceipt — fictional workbook quickstart
info.description:
[CalcReceipt on RapidAPI](https://rapidapi.com/IsraelDiego/api/calcreceipt). Download the [original fictional sample](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/israeldi/flamingo-api-examples/main/calcreceipt/sample.xlsx) (1,822 bytes, SHA-256 cb48733830a433ec3c03b9081d42ded6efb40fc73d38fa43767a7dd2f69262d4). Choose it under Body → binary, with exact Content-Length generated by Postman. Do not send JSON or multipart. A calculated error is deliberately present; HTTP 200 is not a clean workbook or Excel parity guarantee. [Client, source and complete contract](https://github.com/israeldi/flamingo-api-examples/tree/main/calcreceipt).

Subscribe to the specific API on RapidAPI and review its current limits, billing and privacy terms. Import this JSON into your own Postman workspace. Set rapidapi_key as a local value only, leaving shared values empty, or use your local Vault reference. Never publish a key. Use Send once; do not run this in a loop or enable retries/redirects. Failed requests may consume allowance. No request is sent by importing this collection. These fixture-specific tests are intended for the exact original fictional sample; they do not validate arbitrary files. The checks verify selected report fields and encoded byte lengths, not decoded hashes, ZIP/XML integrity, visual accuracy or business correctness. Use the linked standalone client for stronger verification.

variable.description: Your subscribed consumer application key. Set locally or use a local Vault reference; leave this shared value blank.
